result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a broken delivery fee value displaying '€NaN delivery' for one restaurant, indicating a calculation error. The rest of the page renders cleanly.

issues.description: Smash Bros Burgers shows '€NaN delivery' — an unformatted NaN (Not a Number) value leaked into the UI, likely due to a missing or invalid delivery fee in the data.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee data/calculation, and add a fallback in the UI (e.g., hide the fee or show 'Free delivery' / a dash) when the value is null or invalid.
